title: verify.rs error 'not found in certificate bag' omits trust anchors
description: verify.rs:161 returns fail(None, 'signer cert not found in certificate bag') but find_cert() searches both the CMS certificate bag AND the trust anchors. A user debugging why verify() failed on a self-signed cert or a cert whose issuer is a direct trust anchor will be misled into thinking the cert bag is the only place searched. Should read 'signer cert not found in certificate bag or trust anchors'.
